issuing_orgs: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
synopsis: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Statistical and Data Management Centers (SDMCs). The SDMCs will be responsible for the statistical and data management leadership and coordination critical to the HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks.
title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Statistical and Data Management Centers (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
